verdict.rationale: Anytype has its own in-app Web Publishing feature: you pick an Object, click Publish, and it generates a static HTML page on a personal any.org subdomain. That covers publishing selected notes without leaving the app. The evidence only describes single-object pages, so nothing shows that published notes form a browsable, interlinked site. missing for 10: evidence that links between published notes resolve to other published pages, site-level navigation or digital-garden structure across multiple notes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
